name: hud_ui_text_input_backspace_delete_char
description: HudUiTextInput::BackspaceDeleteChar decrements the cursor when it is positive and removes the character before the cursor by shifting text left.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiTextInput class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b4530 validates cursor load, no-op return when cursor <= 0, otherwise decrement cursor, store it, and call HudUiTextInput::ShiftTextLeft(1, cursor - 1).
Native smoke zhud_text_input_constructor_and_alloc_smoke verifies BackspaceDeleteChar after inserting 'X' into 'abcd' at cursor 2 restores the buffer to 'abcd' and leaves cursor at 2.
